message.content:
I'll search for information about altavista.com.

<tool>web_search</tool>
<query>altavista.com history what happened to AltaVista search engine</query>

Based on my search, here's information about **altavista.com**:

AltaVista was one of the first major **web search engines**, launched in **1995** by Digital Equipment Corporation (DEC). It was groundbreaking for its time, offering several innovative features:

- **Fast, full-text search** of web pages
- **Advanced search operators** (Boolean operators, phrase searching)
- **Multilingual search capabilities**
- **The largest index** of web pages at launch (approximately 16 million pages)

## Rise and Fall

AltaVista quickly became one of the most popular search engines in the late 1990s, competing with Yahoo!, Lycos, and Excite. However, it struggled to maintain its position:

- **1998**: DEC was acquired by Compaq
- **1999**: AltaVista was sold to CMGI
- **2003**: Acquired by **Overture Services**, which was then bought by **Yahoo!** the same year

## Shutdown

Yahoo! effectively shut down AltaVista as an independent search engine, redirecting the site to Yahoo! Search. The original **altavista.com** domain now redirects to Yahoo's search page or may show a "domain not found" error, as Yahoo has largely discontinued the brand.

AltaVista is remembered as a pioneer that helped define web search, though it ultimately lost to Google, which launched in 1998 with superior PageRank technology and a cleaner interface.

---

Sources:
1. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/AltaVista
2. https://www.computerhistory.org/timeline/search-engines/
